tools.name: search_doctrine
tools.description: Opinions of the CADA (access to administrative documents), decisions of the Défenseur des droits, conclusions of the CE's rapporteurs publics, BOFiP (tax guidance), Code du travail numérique, CNIL deliberations. These are NOT court decisions: an opinion does not bind the judge. Keywords in French. R

tools.name: get_law_article
tools.description: Article of a French code or statute, as in force on a date (default: today). `code`: abbreviation ("CT", "cc"), name ("code du travail"), LEGITEXT or statute ("loi 91-647", "loi du 1er juillet 1901"); list: about(topic="codes"). European texts: "CEDH" (protocols: num="P1-1"), "CHARTE_UE", "TUE", "TF

tools.name: search_decisions_citing
tools.description:
Court decisions that EXPLICITLY cite an article ("article 1240 du code civil", "art. L. 1152-1 du code du travail"). Does not find indirect references or citations without an article number: searching by concept is for `search`.

Example: search_decisions_citing(code="CC", num="1240")

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Searches all sources (French and European case law, codes and
statutes, Journal officiel, collective agreements, doctrine), expanding to
legal synonyms. Entry point for an open question; for one specific court,
use `search_case_law`. A citation ("Cass. soc. 11 mai 2022", an ECLI, an
appeal number) i

tools.name: search_case_law
tools.description:

decisions: `search_recent_admin_decisions`). Keywords in French.
ECHR, CJEU: texts sometimes in English only.

Example: search_case_law(query="licenciement inaptitude", court="CASS")

tools.name: search_directory
tools.description:
Public addresses and contacts in France: courts, court registries
(greffes), town halls, CCAS, prefectures, public services.

Example: search_directory(query="tribunal judiciaire Dunkerque")

tools.name: about
tools.description:
What JusticeLibre covers (sources, volumes, freshness, terms of use),
the list of administrative courts and their codes, or the list of codes
and statutes accepted by get_law_article.

Example: about(topic="codes")

Args:
    topic: service | courts | codes

tools.name: delete_account_item
tools.description: Permanently deletes one object of the user's JusticeLibre account: a case file (with all its content), a saved reference, a subfolder, a note, or an AI skill proposal not yet activated (`skill`, id s_…, p_… or w_…). No recycle bin. confirm=true states the user's explicit agreement; without it, nothi

tools.name: check_citations
tools.description: Finds where a quoted passage comes from (paste the quotation alone, ≤ 3,000 characters, original language). Check each result against the source (link provided). Returns texts and decisions containing it, with a match % (100 = word for word, ignoring punctuation, case, accents) and word differences.

tools.name: create_account_item
tools.description: Creates one of: a case file, a subfolder, saved references (articles, statutes, decisions, CADA opinions, CNIL deliberations, doctrine), an AI note, a bookmark, a skill proposal (inactive until the user activates it). Never changes existing content. Fields marked "kind: …" apply to that kind only. g

tools.description: Sets the state of an existing case file (title, subtitle, case sheet), subfolder (name), saved reference (subfolder, set aside with a reason) or AI note (text, pinned, set aside).
